InvalidDateRange: The end date must be after the start date
OpticalTanCode: Optical TAN code for a TAN generator. Hold the TAN generator against the bars.
TaxDeductibleHint: Mark categories as tax-relevant in Settings to track deductible expenses.
GettingStartedIntro: Three steps to your first overview.
StepAddBankHint: Enter the bank code and your online-banking login.
StepSyncHint: Sync asks your bank once for your PIN; balances can also be entered by hand.
StepCategorizeHint: Categories and rules group spending and mark what counts for taxes.
NoBookingsSixMonths: No bookings in the last six months
NoBookingsSixMonthsTo: No bookings in the six months to %s
NoBanksDescription: Add your bank, then add its accounts. Balances and transactions can be entered manually until online banking sync is set up.
SyncAllNothingIncluded: No connection is included in Sync all
FetchHistoryHint: Bookings already imported are skipped. Banks limit how far back they go and many ask for a TAN beyond 90 days.
ConnectionNameHint: Only shown in Finglass, e.g. “DKB business”. The bank login stays the same.
OnlineSyncNotYetAvailable: Online sync isn't available in Finglass yet. Import your bank's statements under Transactions.
BankSearchHint: Search bank: name, BLZ, BIC or IBAN
BankSearchNoMatch: No bank found — enter the details below
BankUnknownBlz: BLZ %s is not in the bank directory
AskBankForFints: Ask your bank for its FinTS (PIN/TAN) address
PinNeverStored: Your PIN is asked for on every sync and can't be stored on this system.
PinAskedEverySync: Your PIN is asked for on every sync. Tick “Remember PIN for syncs” in the PIN prompt to keep it in your system's secure credential store.
HistoryReconstructed: History is reconstructed from the current balance and the bookings Finglass knows about.
DeleteAccountText: This deletes %s and all of its transactions. Linked documents are kept but unlinked.
LoanBalanceHint: Enter what you still owe as a negative amount, e.g. -12,000.00.
AccountNameHint: Only shown in Finglass. Leave empty to show “%s”.
RemoveBankText: This deletes the bank, all of its accounts and their transactions.
CentralBlzNote: This bank's online banking uses bank code %1$s for all branches, so Finglass uses it instead of %2$s.
CentralBlzHint: Online banking for this bank uses bank code %s.
BlzNotInDirectory: Not in the bank list. Check the bank code.
BlzOtherBank: This bank code belongs to %s, not to this connection's bank.
LoginResetNote: Changing the bank code, user ID or server URL resets Finglass's registration with the bank. The next sync registers again and may ask you to confirm with a TAN.
BalanceBankMismatch: The bank reports %1$s after this booking. Bookings of %2$s are missing after it, e.g. ones the bank hasn't put in its statement yet.
NoTransactionsAddBank: Add your bank to import or enter transactions.
FileBelongsTo: The file belongs to %s, not the selected account.
FileBelongsToNamed: %s belongs to %s, not the selected account.
ColumnsApplyToSame: Column changes apply to the %d {1:file|files} with these columns.
ImportFilesSkipped: %d {1:file is|files are} skipped because {1:it|they} could not be read.
UnlockText: Your data is encrypted. Enter the passphrase to open it.
ChangePassphraseText: Enter the current passphrase and choose a new one. Finglass re-encrypts your data and then opens it.
CreatePassphraseHeading: Protect your data with a passphrase
CreatePassphraseText: Finglass encrypts its database: accounts, transactions, settings and bank connection keys. You enter this passphrase every time Finglass starts.
EncryptPassphraseText: Your data isn't encrypted yet. Choose a passphrase: Finglass encrypts the database now and asks for the passphrase every time it starts.
PassphraseHint: At least %d characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
DocumentsNotEncrypted: Document files (receipts, invoices) are stored as files and are not encrypted. Turn on FileVault (macOS) or BitLocker (Windows) to protect them.
PassphraseNoRecovery: I understand that nobody can recover my data if I forget this passphrase.
PassphraseSpaces: The passphrase can't start or end with a space.
PassphraseAcknowledge: Confirm that you understand there's no recovery.
RestoredEncryptedHint: A backup was restored. Enter the passphrase that was in effect when the backup was made.
RestoredPlainHint: A backup without encryption was restored.
PlaintextLeftoversTitle: Unencrypted copies of the database are still on disk
PlaintextLeftoversText: Finglass encrypts the database it opens, but these copies in the data folder were left behind by earlier restores, deleted profiles or profiles that were never opened. Anyone who can read this disk can read them without your passphrase. Delete the ones you no longer need.
PlaintextLeftoverPendingRestore: Restore waiting for the next start
UnencryptedLeftoversTitle: Unencrypted documents are still on disk
UnencryptedLeftoversText: Finglass encrypts its database, but the documents in these folders are stored as plain files. They were left behind by restores or deleted profiles. Anyone who can read this disk can read them without your passphrase. Delete a folder yourself once you no longer need it.
EncryptionStatus: Database encrypted (SQLCipher, AES-256). Finglass asks for the passphrase at every start; you can change it on the unlock screen.
EncryptionOff: Database not encrypted (development or test mode).
BackupPassphraseText: This backup was made with a different passphrase. Enter that passphrase to check the backup. Finglass asks for it again at the next start.
BackupNote: Backups stay encrypted with the passphrase in effect when they are made.
ProfilesHint: Each profile has its own accounts, transactions, documents and bank connections.
DeleteProfileText: The data of %s is moved to the profiles-deleted folder. Nothing is erased: the folder, unencrypted documents included, stays until you delete it yourself.
ProfileSwitchBusy: Finish the running task before switching profiles.
WrongCurrencySkipped: %1$d {1:booking is|bookings are} in another currency than this %2$s account and will be skipped.
OtherCurrenciesExcluded: All amounts in %1$s. %2$d {2:booking|bookings} in other currencies {2:is|are} not included.
PrimaryCurrencyHint: Dashboard, budgets and reports add up bookings in this currency only. Amounts are never converted.
SetAccountBalance: Set the account balance from the newest booking in the file
SetAccountBalanceClosing: Set the account balance to %s (the file's closing balance)
SetAccountBalanceClosingPending: Set the account balance to %1$s (the file's closing balance without its %2$d pending entries)
NewerBookingsUnchanged: The account has newer bookings than this file, so its balance is left unchanged.
BookingsSkippedHint: Bookings imported before are skipped, as are ones that match an existing booking from another source (sync or manual entry) by date and amount.
ErrorImportTooManyFiles: Select at most %d files at once.
ErrorImportFilesTooLarge: The selected files are larger than %d MB together.
ErrorImportNoReadableFile: None of the selected files could be read: %s
ErrorImportDifferentAccounts: The files belong to different accounts (%s). Import one account at a time.
ErrorImportStopped: Import stopped at %s: %s. %d {3:file was|files were} imported before it.
DeleteGroupText: Delete group “%s”? Its accounts move back to their default group.
DragToGroupHint: Drop on a group to move the account
OcrNotInstalled: Text in images and scanned PDFs can't be read until Tesseract is installed (see %s). PDFs with text work without it.
SearchDocuments: Search documents by name or text content…
UploadHint: Upload receipts, invoices and statements (PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF).
DeleteDocumentText: %s and its stored copy will be deleted.
SuggestedMatches: Suggested matches (amount and date from the document)
ReportsBuiltFrom: Reports are built from the transactions of the selected period.
NoTaxRelevantExpenses: No tax-relevant expenses. Mark categories as tax-relevant in Settings (e.g. Arbeitsmittel, Spenden, Versicherungen).
RecurringHint: Detected from the last 13 months once something repeats at least three times (yearly: twice).
AboutText: Your financial workspace: accounts, FinTS banking, documents and tax reports. Alpha software — not for use with real bank accounts.
AboutTypeface: Typeface: IBM Plex Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
FixDuplicateColours: Give each category its own colour
CategoryIsTransferHint: Not counted as income or spending. Use it for credit-card payments only when the card's own bookings are imported.
RulesHint: A rule's pattern is a case-insensitive regular expression matched against partner name and purpose, or only one of them, for expenses, income or both. Higher priority wins; on equal priority the older rule wins.
NoRulesYet: No rules yet. Add one, or import a rules file.
MessageRulesExportSkipped: %1$d {1:rule|rules} exported, %2$d skipped (tab or line break in pattern or category)
RuleFileErrorCategory: Category is empty or longer than 100 characters
RuleFileErrorPriority: Priority is not a whole number: %s
RuleFileErrorAutoApply: auto_apply must be true or false: %s
ErrorRuleFileHeader: Not a Finglass rule file: the header line is missing or wrong
ErrorRuleFileTooLarge: Rule file too large (at most 1 MB and 5000 rules)
ErrorRuleFileEncoding: The rule file is not valid UTF-8 text
TesseractMissing: Tesseract not found. Install with: brew install tesseract tesseract-lang
BackupHint: A backup contains the database, all stored documents and the online-banking connection files.
RestoreWaiting: A restore is waiting. Restart Finglass to apply it.
BackupRestoredAt: Backup restored at this start. Your previous data is in %s
RestoreExplanation: On the next start, all current data is replaced by this backup. The current data is moved to a pre-restore folder, not deleted; it stays there, unencrypted documents included, until you delete it yourself.
DeleteCategoryText: Its transactions become uncategorized and its rules are deleted.
DeleteRuleText: Bookings it already categorized keep their category.
Name: Name
PriorityMustBeNumber: Priority must be a whole number
RememberPinExplanation: Kept in your system's secure credential store, never in Finglass's files.
TanDefaultMessage: Enter the TAN shown by your TAN procedure.
TanFlickerUnsupported: chipTAN flicker codes are not supported in this build yet. Enter the TAN shown on the generator.
MessageNoDeletedRemembered: No deleted bookings are remembered for this account
MessageRuleCreated: Rule created and applied to %d uncategorized {1:transaction|transactions}
MessageColoursAlreadyDistinct: Every category already has its own colour
MessageRestorePrepared: Restore prepared. Restart Finglass to finish; your current data will be kept in a pre-restore folder.
PinNotSaved: The PIN could not be saved in the system's secure credential store.
ErrorConnectionBusy: Wait until the sync of this bank has finished.
ErrorDeleteWhileBusy: Wait until the running sync or import has finished.
AccountIbanExists: An account with this IBAN already exists
DuplicateTransactionText: This account already has a booking on %s for %s with the same partner and purpose. Add a second one, for example for a repeated purchase?
ErrorSyncFromDateFuture: The start date must not be in the future
ErrorBankRejectedStatements: The bank rejected the statement request
StatementsNotSupported: Statements not supported for this account
ErrorNoFintsServer: No FinTS server known for BLZ %s. Enter the bank's FinTS URL.
ErrorEnterUserId: Enter your online banking user ID (Anmeldename/Legitimations-ID) for %s.
HintNothingToExport: No transactions in this view to export
ErrorBankUnreachable: Could not reach the bank's FinTS server. Check the server URL and your internet connection.
ErrorServerHttpStatus: The bank's server answered with HTTP %d. Check that FinTS/HBCI access is activated in your online banking and that the bank code (BLZ) and server URL of this connection are right, or try again later.
ErrorServerNotFints: The bank's server sent an answer that isn't FinTS (%s). Check the FinTS server URL in the connection settings. If it is right, the bank may be blocking the request: try again later or capture a protocol trace in Settings.
ErrorPassportReset: Finglass could not reset its stored bank registration. Remove and re-add this bank.
ProtocolTraceHint: Collect a log of the next online-banking dialogs to help diagnose connection problems. PIN, TAN, user id and account numbers are masked, but the log contains your bank's full answers: names, purposes, amounts and balances. Read it before you share it. Traces stay in memory until you save them and are never sent automatically.
ProtocolTraceAvailable: A trace is ready to save.
ProtocolTraceNone: No trace captured yet. Enable collection, reproduce the problem (e.g. run a sync), then save it here.
ErrorNoProtocolTrace: No protocol trace captured yet. Enable collection and reproduce the problem first.
BalanceNotProvided: …%s: the bank sends no balance for this account (%s). Enter it with “Edit balance”; a loan as a negative amount.
BalanceNotProvidedNoCode: …%s: the bank sends no balance for this account. Enter it with “Edit balance”; a loan as a negative amount.
SyncGapNotFetched: Bookings from %s to %s were not fetched: Finglass fetches at most the last %d days. Use “Fetch history from…” to get them (the bank may ask for a TAN).
SyncAccountWithoutIban: %s: the bank lists this account without an IBAN; Finglass can't store it yet.
SyncBalanceOtherCurrency: …%s: the bank reported the balance in %s, but the account is kept in %s; the balance was not changed.
SyncCurrencyCorrected: …%s: the account's currency was corrected from %s to %s, as the bank reports its balance in that currency and states no account currency.
ImportSummaryWrongCurrency: , %d in another currency than the account skipped
ErrorImportSeveralAccounts: This file holds bookings for %d accounts (%s). Export one file per account and import them one at a time.
ErrorXlsxTooLarge: The Excel file is too large or damaged.
ErrorXlsxUnreadable: The Excel file could not be read.
ErrorDocumentTooLarge: %s is too large (the limit is %d MB)
ErrorImageTooLarge: %s has too many pixels to read
PdfAllAmountsIn: All amounts in %s. %d {2:booking|bookings} in other currencies {2:is|are} not included.
PdfNoTaxRelevant: No categories are marked as tax-relevant.
FlickerHint: Hold the TAN generator against the bars so its arrows line up with the triangles.
IbanOrCardLast4: IBAN or last 4 digits of the card
CardLast4Only: Enter only the last 4 digits of the card.
ErrorBankOffline: This bank is offline: nothing is sent to the bank.
ReapplyRulesWarning: Categories you set by hand are overwritten too. Narrow the list with the filters first if needed. You can undo this afterwards from the menu.
MessageReapplyNothing: No shown booking would get a different category
DeleteSyncedHint: Deleted bookings are remembered, so a later import or bank sync won't add them again. To allow that, use “Allow deleted bookings again” in the account's menu on the Accounts screen. Linked receipts are kept and only unlinked.
TaxSuggestionsHint: Matched by keyword. Accept marks the booking tax relevant; dismiss hides the suggestion for good. The keywords are editable in Settings.
TaxBookingsHowTo: Mark a category as tax relevant in Settings → Categories, give a rule a Tax option, or mark bookings in the transaction list.
ErrorTaxExportFailed: The export of the tax report failed
ComingSoon: This screen is coming in a later milestone.
ErrorFinDeskNotFound: No FinDesk database was found in the selected folder.
ErrorFinDeskNotFinDesk: This database is not a FinDesk database.
ErrorFinDeskTargetNotEmpty: The Finglass profile already contains data. Create a new profile in the Profiles section and import there.
FinDeskImportSummary: Imported %d account groups, %d bank connections, %d accounts, %d categories, %d rules, %d transactions, %d deleted bookings, %d pending bookings, %d documents, %d OCR texts and %d settings. Skipped %d rows, %d documents with a missing file and %d refused documents. Left %d payment orders behind.
FinDeskImportHint: Copies accounts, bank connections, categories, rules, bookings and documents from FinDesk into the open profile. Payment orders and remembered PINs are not imported. Quit FinDesk first.
FinDeskPassphraseText: Enter the passphrase of the selected FinDesk database. It is used once for this import and is not stored.
FinDeskImportSkipped: Skipped: %d rows without their account, category or document, %d invalid rows, %d with a fractional cent amount, and %d settings Finglass does not use.
ErrorFinDeskNotAFolder: The selected folder is not a FinDesk folder.
ErrorNotEncrypted: This data folder contains an unencrypted database, which Finglass cannot open.
ErrorDatabaseTooNew: This database was created by a newer version of Finglass.
ErrorAlreadyRunning: Finglass is already running with this data folder.
ErrorStartupFailed: Finglass could not prepare this profile's data at startup. Quit Finglass and try again.
ErrorOnlineSyncUnavailable: Online sync is not available in this build yet.
ErrorServerUrlRequired: The FinTS server URL is required
ErrorServerUrlMustBeHttps: The FinTS server URL must start with https://
MigrationWelcomeText: Finglass can take over your FinDesk profiles now. Each FinDesk profile becomes a Finglass profile with the same name.
MigrationCopiedText: Accounts, bank connections, categories, rules, bookings and documents are copied. Payment orders and remembered PINs are not. Bank logins must sign in again.
MigrationSamePassphrase: Use the same passphrase for Finglass
MigrationNewPassphraseNeeded: The FinDesk passphrase does not meet Finglass's rules for a new passphrase. Choose a new one.
ErrorFinDeskSourceChanged: FinDesk seems to be running. Quit FinDesk and try again.
ErrorMigrationTargetNotEmpty: The Finglass profile already contains data. Nothing was migrated.
TestConnectionHelp: Runs a read-only check against your bank. Nothing is imported. Your bank may ask you to approve a new device.
TestConnectionTanMethodUnsupported: The bank's TAN method is not supported. Choose pushTAN in your bank settings.
TestConnectionStatementsUnavailable: The bank did not provide statements.
TestConnectionProductID: The FinTS product id is missing or invalid.
ErrorConnectionTrace: The redacted trace could not be saved.
ProductIDPromptText: Enter the FinTS product registration id. It is used only for this test and is not stored.
